map.腹水 SAAG（血清-腹水白蛋白梯度）鉴别 使用指南: Ascitic SAAG (Serum-Ascites Albumin Gradient) Differential User Guide
map.算法：SAAG = 血清白蛋白 − 腹水白蛋白（g/L）。≥11 g/L 提示门: Algorithm: SAAG = serum albumin − ascites albumin (g/L). A value of 11 g/L or more indicates portal hypertensive ascites (cirrhosis about 80%, Budd-Chiari, right heart failure, portal vein thrombosis, fulminant hepatic failure); below 11 g/L indicates non-portal hypertensive…
map.性质鉴别：由 SAAG 区分门脉高压性与非门脉高压性腹水: Property discrimination: SAAG separates portal hypertensive from non-portal hypertensive ascites
map.病因缩小：门脉高压者结合腹水总蛋白定肝源/心源/布加: Narrow the cause: in portal hypertension, use the total ascites protein to separate hepatic, cardiac and Budd-Chiari causes
map.采样规范：同一日内采样、输注白蛋白后间隔再测: Sampling protocol: sample within the same day and leave an interval after an albumin infusion
map.故应在未输注白蛋白时同次采集血清与腹水，或输注后间隔足够时间再测，否则结果不可靠: So the serum and ascites should be collected in the same draw when albumin has not been infused, or measured after a sufficient interval; otherwise the result is unreliable
map.为什么输注白蛋白会影响 SAAG？: Why does infusing albumin affect SAAG?
map.输白蛋白会抬高血清白蛋白、人为拉大梯度，造成假门脉高压印象。故应在未输注白蛋白时: Infusing albumin raises the serum albumin and artificially inflates the gradient, creating a false impression of portal hypertension. So the serum and ascites should be collected in the same draw when albumin has not been infused, or measured after a sufficient interval; otherwise the result is unreliable.
map.不一定。SAAG≥11 只说明存在门脉高压，最常见是肝硬化，但也见于布-加综合征: Not always. SAAG ≥ 11 only indicates portal hypertension; the most common cause is cirrhosis, but it is also seen in Budd-Chiari syndrome, right heart failure, portal vein thrombosis and fulminant hepatic failure. The cause must be narrowed down using the total ascites protein, cardiac ultrasound, abdominal imaging and the history.
